verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a support article titled "Back up your BitLocker recovery key" (windows-docs-14). It implies Windows ships full-disk encryption via BitLocker, but nothing shows it turns on automatically without manual setup. Missing for 10: documentation that BitLocker or device encryption is on by default, which editions and hardware get automatic encryption, how the recovery key is escrowed automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
